Ben — thanks for the summary and for the docs. Quick responses:
- Procurement: leaning monthly but I need confirmation from our finance ops — looping procurement.
- Legal: we redlined Exhibit B because the 99.9% target is OK but the remedies are structured differently in our standard terms (we prefer service credits capped at 10% rather than termination rights for repeated breaches).

Legal (cc): can Redwood propose language that maps your SLA tiers to our remedies? Also we need SOC2 Type II evidence and an updated data retention table for the order form.

I attached our high‑level redline for Exhibit B in the PDF you sent.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Maria

Subject: FW: Renewal sequencing and exhibits — Solarnova redlines (need legal input)

Laura / legal — forwarding Solarnova's redlines for Exhibit B and request for SOC2 evidence. Key asks from customer: swap remedy structure to credits capped at 10% and map our SLA tiers into their remedy framework; confirm data retention table entries for the Order Form (they want explicit retention periods by artifact).

Notes / constraints:
- They are committed to the 24‑month term and the capacity uplift; procurement only needs cadence confirmation (likely monthly). If we accept credits cap, we should confirm whether that affects our standard termination carve for repeated breaches — recommend we keep a limited termination right for severity level 2+ events.
- SOC2: we can share the Type II summary and an internal report redaction (stub attached).

Proposed approach:
1) Laura reviews and suggests Exhibit B language we can send to Solarnova as Redwood_Proposed_ExhibitB_v2.docx
2) Ben confirms billing cadence and pushes procurement to sign off by 5/18
3) I will produce a consolidated redline and a short cover letter explaining changes to remedies vs. their standard template

Attachments: Solarnova_Redlines_v1.pdf (from customer).

-Jonas

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@solarnova.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal sequencing and exhibits — proposed Exhibit B language and evidence pack

Maria — thanks for the clarity and for the redline. We reviewed your Exhibit B requests and propose the following compromise (attached):

- Remedy structure: accept service credits with a 10% annual cap but retain a limited termination right where Redwood experiences two consecutive Sev 1 or three Sev 2 incidents within a 90‑day rolling window. This preserves operational protection for both parties.
- Data retention: we will add the explicit retention table to the Order Form outlining logs (90 days), request metadata (13 months), and backups (12 months) — see Redwood_Proposed_ExhibitB_v2.docx.
- SOC2: attached is a redacted SOC2 Type II summary. We cannot share the full report without an NDA; happy to initiate an evidence NDA if your legal team prefers the full document.

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_ExhibitB_v2.docx (proposed clean text), SOC2_Type2_Redwood_stub.pdf (redacted summary), DocuSign_Solarnova_Order_2026.link.txt (prepped order bundle for signature).

If this sounds acceptable, Ben and Jonas — please route the revised Order Form + Exhibit B back to Maria/procurement and include the DocuSign link. Lauren — please prepare a short customer note for post‑signature onboarding outlining the capacity upgrade timeline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Proposed_ExhibitB_v2.docx (docx)]
